check_evidence.description: An invinoveritas verdict proof: the signed NIP-01 event (kind 30078, tag schema=invinoveritas.verdict_proof.v1) returned by POST /review with sign=true, either bare or as {"event": ...}. Issued on the canonical JSON of the action (sorted keys, no spaces).

claims.establishes: The presented event's id recomputes from its fields, it is an invinoveritas verdict proof, and its BIP-340 signature verifies under the pinned invinoveritas key.
limits: Says nothing about the action unless verdict_covers_action is also established
Trusts the pinned key; key rotation or revocation is not checked in this version

claims.establishes: The verdict was issued on exactly this action: its artifact_hash equals SHA-256 of the action's sorted-key JSON. The established result's reason carries the subject, subject:action_sha256=<hex>.
limits: Binds the action bytes only, not the tenant, approval id or operation id
The same verdict can be presented again for the same action; single use is the approval's job

claims.establishes: The verdict on this exact action is one the customer accepts (accept_verdicts, default approve) and was signed no more than max_age_s (default 900) before the evaluation instant.
limits: A verdict is an independent judgement, not a guarantee that the action is correct or safe
Freshness uses the event's signed created_at and the runtime's clock; there is no trusted time source

claims.establishes: The verdict covers this action and the dispatch target is inside the hashed action (args[target_field], default "target") and equals the runtime dispatch target, exact string: CheckInput.target when the runtime passes one (proposed for v1), otherwise declared_target in config (the v0 stand-in). The established result's reason carries the subject, subject:target=<target>.
limits: A target outside the hashed action is never covered: not_established with target_not_in_hashed_action
Exact string match only: no redirect following, no alias or normalization rules
With neither a runtime target nor declared_target: not_established with no_runtime_target
Says nothing about what the executor actually dispatches to

profiles.description: NIP-01 event, kind 30078, BIP-340 over the event id, content.artifact_hash = sha256 hex of the reviewed artifact bytes

keys.purpose: verify verdict signatures (public key 6786e18a864893a900bd9858e650f67ccc3513f248fed374b591e2ff6922fbb7, published at https://api.babyblueviper.com/.well-known/nostr.json)
keys.lifecycle: pinned in config; no rotation in v0.1
